invoice_contract.dirty_slot_from_ground: If an independent dirty original z starts and must return at ground, acquiring and undoing its S8 chart requires separately priced transport; the kernel does not fund it. Use the zero-owned variant to avoid that assumption.
invoice_contract.if_D6_main_prefix_already_paid: D6->S8 is one H2 per participating field, not one H2 per complete channel
invoice_contract.if_D6_not_present: The six radical directions remain a genuine Gaussian prefix cost; no H2-only acquisition from ground is claimed. Ground->S8 has rank8.
invoice_contract.main_prefix_and_termination: Every main field must actually reach S8 at the same cut, after each source own-line service and before each reader own-line service; global schedule, transitions, productive targets and complete invoice remain unproved.

phase_evaluation.field_width: Every positive f under inherited columnwise tensor semantics.
phase_evaluation.method: Fresh sparse exact Gaussian-integer column evaluator for the pinned Clifford compiler; equality of signed tableau and one absolute column fixes global phase.

scalar_kernel.typed_entry: 68 source+68 reader fields already in identical physical canonical S8 chart; their logical originals independent
scalar_kernel.typed_exit: source values unchanged; reader_r += a_r sum_s b_s source_s, all in S8; borrowed dirty cache returns its original z in S8
